name: How much does a premises liability attorney cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a premises liability attorney cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most premises liability attorneys work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay any upfront fees or hourly rates. Instead, the attorney's fee is a percentage of the compensation they recover for you, either through a settlement or a court award. If your case is unsuccessful, you typically do not owe any attorney fees. This arrangement allows individuals to pursue justice without immediate financial burden.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most premises liability attorneys charge a contingency fee, meaning they are paid a percentage of your settlement or award only if they win.
